note: Geometry is a public GrabCAD X8 coaxial octorotor sample standing in for a real AXOM airframe. Canonical keys read from the converted GLB with cad-pipeline/inspect_glb_nodes.mjs. Coaxial pairing (which motor body and mount belong to which propeller) was resolved by matching XZ position and stack height, not by name order. All `website` figures are illustrative placeholders, not specifications.

propellor_stable3_2#92.description: Upper rotor of the forward coaxial pair. In an X8 each arm carries two rotors on a shared axis, so a single motor failure costs roughly half that arm's thrust rather than all of it.

specs.note: Both blades are one watertight solid with no separable mesh island, so a rigid pitch is geometrically impossible here.

propellor_stable3_5#129.description: Lower rotor of the forward coaxial pair, turning opposite to the upper. It works in the upper rotor's downwash, which is why a coaxial pair produces less thrust than two separated rotors of the same size.

truba15_560#0.description: Longitudinal 15 mm carbon tube forming the airframe spine. The two lateral tubes cross it at the centre plate to make the four-arm cruciform.

truba15_275#1.description: Starboard half of the lateral boom pair.

truba15_275_1#2.description: Port half of the lateral boom pair.

plastina#3.description: Clamps the spine and lateral tubes together and carries the avionics stack. Every arm load passes through this plate.

power_plate#158.description: Copper-plane board splitting pack current to the eight speed controllers.

apm2_5#160.description: Autopilot board carrying the inertial sensors and barometer. Its barometric altitude is what a real ceiling limit would be enforced against.

GPS#196.description: Satellite navigation receiver, raised above the airframe on its own plate to keep it clear of electrical noise from the power stage.

gps_plate#197.description: Standoff plate lifting the GNSS receiver above the avionics stack.

radio#212.description: Bidirectional command and telemetry link to the ground station.

LiPo#209.description: First of two lithium-polymer packs. Splitting the pack in two lets the mass sit symmetrically either side of the centre plate.

LiPo_1#211.description: Second lithium-polymer pack, mounted opposite the first.

esc#204.description: Electronic speed controllers for the upper rotor set.

esc_1#205.description: Electronic speed controllers for the lower rotor set.

ugolok350#29.description: Angled skid spreading touchdown load across the two starboard legs.

ugolok350_1#30.description: Angled skid spreading touchdown load across the two port legs.

website.tagline: Coaxial octorotor with rotor-out redundancy for heavier payloads.
